facts.fact: Clyde & Co says the Cybercrimes Act 19 of 2020 was enacted in 2021 and is the legal framework under which cybercriminals are prosecuted.
Clyde & Co says the Bellville Specialised Commercial Crimes Court on 3 June 2025 convicted Lucky Erasmus on 17 Cybercrimes Act charges and sentenced him to eight years, three suspended.
